name: cache-keepalive
description: Keep Claude Code's prompt cache warm across idle pauses. A Stop/UserPromptSubmit hook stamps activity; an asyncRewake Stop hook waits in the background and wakes the session only once the cache has been untouched long enough (default 50 min), which triggers a cache read and refreshes the prompt-cache TTL. Works in the CLI and the desktop app. Built for a 1h cache TTL; on request-quota subscriptions every ping eats quota, so disable it there.
